Epitasis: The 'intensification' phase of a forecast, typically a 5-day window where natal promises are triggered by current transits.
Chronocrator: Time-lord. A planet designated as the ruler of a specific period in a native's life (e.g., in Firdaria or Profections).
Almuten Figuris: The 'Winner of the Chart'. The single most powerful planet based on essential and accidental dignity across key points (Sun, Moon, Ascendant, etc.).
Hyleg: The giver of life. A planet or point that represents the vital force and physical longevity in a chart.
Alcocoden: The giver of years. A planet that aspects the Hyleg and determines the length of life based on its dignity and condition.
Sect: A fundamental division of astrology into Day (Diurnal) and Night (Nocturnal) influences. Sect determines which planets are benefics or malefics for a specific chart.
Essential Dignity: The strength a planet derives from its position in the zodiac (Domicile, Exaltation, Triplicity, Term, Face).
Accidental Dignity: The strength a planet derives from its current motion and position in the houses (Angular, Speed, Solar proximity, etc.).
Combustion: A debilitated state where a planet is within 8 degrees of the Sun, 'burned' and rendered invisible and ineffective.
Cazimi: A powerful state where a planet is in the 'heart of the Sun' (within 17 minutes), granting it extreme authority and luck.
Antiscia: The 'shadow' or mirror of a planet across the Solstice axis (Cancer/Capricorn). It represents hidden influences or secret allies.
Horary Physics: The application of traditional aspect and motion rules (Transfer of Light, Collection, Prohibition) to determine if a question's outcome will 'perfect'.
Zodiacal Releasing: A sophisticated predictive technique that 'unrolls' the timeline of a specific Lot (Fortune or Spirit) to identify peak periods of activity or reputation.
Firdaria: A system of planetary periods and sub-periods where each planet rules a chunk of time in a set order determined by the chart's sect.
Profection: A symbolic motion where the Ascendant or a planet moves forward by one sign per unit of time (typically one sign per year).
